title: Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026 In Cupertino (oct-17th)
description: Experience the Grandeur of Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026
long_description:
Experience the Grandeur of Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026
Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of India on the 17th of October, 2026 at the Durga Puja & Diwali Festival in Cupertino. Organized by WomenNow TV, this colorful extravaganza promises a day filled with Hindi and Multilingual music, Gujarati Navratri/Dandiya dances, a dazzling fashion show, and a night party to remember. Don't miss out on this mesmerizing blend of tradition and modernity that brings the spirit of India to the heart of California.
Introducing the Stars of the Show
While the artist lineup for the event is yet to be announced, past festivals organized by WomenNow TV have featured a kaleidoscope of talent from across the globe. From renowned musicians to celebrated dancers, audiences can expect a showcase of artistic brilliance. Stay tuned for more updates on the star-studded lineup that is sure to set the stage on fire!
Monta Vista High School: The Perfect Backdrop for a Cultural Fiesta
The festival will be held at Monta Vista High School, situated at 21840 McClellan Road, Cupertino, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue is perfect for families and individuals alike. Compliment your festival experience by visiting the nearby Indian restaurants for a taste of authentic Indian cuisine. Parking will not be a hassle as there is ample space available at the venue.
Secure Your Tickets Today for a Day of Enthralling Entertainment
Choose from a variety of ticket options to suit your preferences. The Oct 17 Day Pass for $10 provides access to the Saptami & Ashtami Pujo, Sandhi Pujo, Parama Awards & DJ Night from 11:00 AM–4:00 PM & 6:30 PM–9:30 PM. For early birds, the $5 Morning Pass offers entry to the Saptami & Ashtami Pujo from 11:00 AM–4:00 PM. Alternatively, enjoy a Royal Bhog Lunch with the Saptami & Ashtami Special ticket for $17, available after 1:00 PM. Please note, a valid event entry ticket is required for this option. Free parking is available, and kids under 5 can join in the fun for free, with a dedicated kids play area to keep them entertained.
